title: My girls aren't impressed
text:
This month was my first month getting the boxcat box. I decided to try the Luxury box; normally $35.99 a month, my first box discount priced it at $29.99. Included was:
* Chicken treats.
* A little bunny thing with 2 puffballs.
* A carrot.
* A mat.
* A string-powered jitterpig.
* A little jangleball.

1. My cats LOVE their food, normally, but kept spitting the treats back out of their mouths as soon as they picked them up :( Additionally there was no nutritional value provided such as estimated caloric or protein content, so I feel hesitant to pass the unused treats to one of my other cat-owning friends.
2. The little jitter toy only moved long enough to make them look at it, then I would have to touch it again and the girls would get distracted.
3. I think the carrot was intended as a kicker toy, but they were only interested in tearing up the tissue paper. And unless the carrot is their "skincare, wellness item or cat gear item", that item is missing from the box.
The quality of the mat isn't what I expected from a "luxury" addition, to be honest- it feels very handmade and flimsy, and my cats immediately disregarded it- and overall what we got doesn't feel like the kind of thing I would expect from a box that costs $36/month.
label: negative
